context: I am building a logistics operations platform for dispatch teams. Operators need to track shipments, monitor fleet health, resolve delivery exceptions, and understand route progress quickly.
goals: Help operators identify delivery exceptions immediately.
Help dispatch managers assign vehicles and monitor route progress.
Make shipment status visible without relying on color alone.
businessGoals: Reduce time to resolve delivery exceptions.
Improve operational visibility for dispatch teams.
